split_mapping.val: dev split mapped to val (states 23-27, 90 episodes)
split_mapping.held_out: NOT USED in V2 — all 370 episodes assigned to train or val
split_mapping.note: train_sc5_v2.py maps 'dev' manifest entries to split='val'. No held-out set.

architecture.name: SC5_MLP_v2
architecture.note_confidence: Confidence head retained for v1 architecture compatibility. No loss, no gradient, unused at inference.
architecture.note: Architecture is IDENTICAL to SC5-v1. Only weights change via retraining on new data.

vla_model.note: VLA 7B model is NEVER trained. Only used for offline trajectory generation.

teacher.usage: Offline labeling only. NOT used during training or inference.

phase.note: 9-class phase classification with auto-computed inverse-frequency class weights

corridor.note: Binary corridor-active detection, pos_weight=5 to counter class imbalance

confidence_head.note: No loss, no gradient — retained for v1 checkpoint compatibility only

early_stopping.note: Save checkpoint with lowest validation phase cross-entropy

training.note_seeds: 5 fixed seeds to assess initialization sensitivity. Report mean ± std across seeds.

checkpoint_selection_rule.step_1_constraint: Primary-dev TV coverage (recall) must not be significantly below SC5-v1 baseline
checkpoint_selection_rule.step_2_objective: Among checkpoints satisfying step 1, minimize NC false-trigger rate on combined dev
checkpoint_selection_rule.step_3_tiebreak: Prefer better primary-dev metrics before reserve-dev metrics
checkpoint_selection_rule.note: Do NOT select checkpoint by maximizing combined accuracy on the NC-rich combined dev set.

baseline_comparison.requirement: Compare SC5-v1 vs SC5-v2 on IDENTICAL dev manifest. Same 25D input, same architecture, same inference thresholds. Improvement must be attributable to new data, not structural changes.
